arabic text: Zindagi ho gayi veeran – maa tere jaane se
english translation text: Life has become desolate since you departed, Mother.

arabic text: Ghar bhi ab lagta hai sunsaan maa terejaane se
english translation text: Even the home now feels deserted since you departed, Mother.

arabic text: Tere hote huwe, hote the zamane mere\nLagte hai ab sabhi anjaan
english translation text: While you were here, the whole world felt like mine;\nnow everyone seems like a stranger.

arabic text: Baithkar paas mere, baatein jahan karti thi\nSuna woh ho gaya daalaan
english translation text: The courtyard where you sat beside me and spoke\nhas now become silent.

arabic text: Kitne dukh maine diye, Tune woh has kar hi sahe\nSoch kar mein hoon pashemaan
english translation text: How much pain I caused you, yet you endured it smiling;\nwhen I think of it, I feel ashamed.

arabic text: Muskura deti thi tu, dekh kar nadim mujh ko\nKho gai woh tere muskaan
english translation text: You would smile when you saw me remorseful;\nthat smile of yours has now disappeared.

arabic text: Maut aajati mujhe, maa teri khidmat kar ke\nReh gaya dil mein yeh armaan
english translation text: I wished death would come to me while serving you, Mother;\nthat longing remained within my heart.

arabic text: Hai bada ghar bhi mera, Paas hai daulat bji bohot\nPhir bhi rehta hoon pareshan
english translation text: My house is large, and I possess great wealth,\nyet I remain troubled.

arabic text: Jaate jaate bhi dua, jeene ki di tune mujhe\nAb wahi hai tere pehchaan
english translation text: Even as you departed, you prayed that I should live;\nthat prayer is now your lasting identity.

arabic text: Baad mere bhi yoonhi, saath mein sab mil ke rahe\nYaad aata hai yeh farmaan
english translation text: After I am gone, remain united in the same way;\nI remember this command of yours.

arabic text: Har taraf dhoondhti hai, meri nigahen tujhko\nTeri yaad aati hai har baar
english translation text: My eyes search for you in every direction;\nyour memory returns again and again.

arabic text: Tune shabbir pe, rona bhi sikhaya hai mujhe\nYaad kitney karoon ahsaan
english translation text: You also taught me how to weep for Shabbir;\nhow many of your favours can I remember?

arabic text: Maa se liptey huwe, rote huwe kehte they hussain\nJaati hai ab yeh meri jaan
english translation text: Clinging to his mother and weeping, Hussain said:\nmy life is now departing.

arabic text: Tukde kasim ke huwe, akbaro asgar na rahe\nLut gaya sab sare maidan
english translation text: Qasim was torn into pieces; Akbar and Asghar remained no more;\neverything was plundered across the battlefield.

arabic text: Rote rote yahi kehte, the shuja aur shahab\nHum huwe besaro samaan\nMaa tere jaane se
english translation text: Weeping, Shuja and Shahab continued to say:\nwe have become destitute and without support\nsince you departed, Mother.
